Brothers, children of the stock of Abraham, and those among you who fear God, the word of this salvation is sent out to…
Neither, because they are Abraham’s offspring, are they all children. But, “your offspring will be accounted as from…
They said this testing him, that they might have something to accuse him of. But Jesus stooped down and wrote on the…
But now you seek to kill me, a man who has told you the truth which I heard from God. Abraham didn’t do this.
Therefore they took up stones to throw at him, but Jesus was hidden, and went out of the temple, having gone through…
For this cause the Jews persecuted Jesus, and sought to kill him, because he did these things on the Sabbath.
After these things, Jesus was walking in Galilee, for he wouldn’t walk in Judea, because the Jews sought to kill him.
Didn’t Moses give you the law, and yet none of you keeps the law? Why do you seek to kill me?”
Therefore some of them of Jerusalem said, “Isn’t this he whom they seek to kill?
Therefore Jews took up stones again to stone him.
So from that day forward they took counsel that they might put him to death.
Why don’t you understand my speech? Because you can’t hear my word.
But because I tell the truth, you don’t believe me.

people.name: Abraham
people.line: Patriarch, chosen by God to father His people

translations.web: I know that you are Abraham’s offspring, yet you seek to kill me, because my word finds no place in you.
translations.bsb: I know you are Abraham’s descendants, but you are trying to kill Me because My word has no place within you.
translations.kjv: I know that ye are Abraham's seed; but ye seek to kill me, because my word hath no place in you.
translations.asv: I know that ye are Abraham's seed: yet ye seek to kill me, because my word hath not free course in you.
